outcome: labor intervention rate (oxytocin augmentation, artificial membrane rupture, lateral episiotomy)
cohort: The study included 5806 nulliparous women with singleton full-term pregnancies diagnosed with hypertensive disorder of pregnancy (HDP).
finding: Zhang's guideline for managing HDP effectively reduced intrapartum cesarean sections and labor interventions but was associated with higher rates of postpartum hemorrhage (PPH) and forceps delivery compared to the 1994 WHO partograph.
mod_finding: Zhang's guideline significantly reduced intrapartum cesarean rates but increased forceps-assisted delivery rates and postpartum hemorrhage compared to the 1994 WHO partograph.
